description:
Issue listing and query subset rendering use the shared issue-list renderer directly, removing the intermediate method reintroduced during query dispatch migration.

## Background

`IssueListing::render` duplicates the rendering entry point beside `HumanRender`. It was removed during output consolidation and returned when query subset headings were added. The final output contract requires rendering through `HumanRender` and one shared issue-list helper.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Issue listing and search results have no separate intermediate `render` method; their human rendering enters through `HumanRender` and uses the shared issue-list helper.
- [hard] REQ-02: Issue-list and query-subset JSON, human text, quiet output and exit statuses are unchanged, with existing semantic rendering coverage preserved.
- [hard] REQ-03: The repair introduces no parallel renderer abstraction and has a nonpositive production-line delta under the default production-line counter.
title: Issue listing renders directly through the shared output contract
